annotations.title: Check a deck against its design system

description: List where a deck is off-brand: colours, fonts and sizes that are not its theme's tokens, with the token each should be. Counts one finding per off-theme value across the whole deck (an element with three literal colours is three findings), so the number is not the editor's per-slide layout-issue count. Reads only. Names the design system version the deck is grounded in, or says it has none.
name: check_deck_compliance
title: Check a deck against its design system
